summary: Families who left {place} receive word that the governor has lifted the advisory.
realLife: Pennsylvania lifted its precaution for pregnant residents and young children on April 9, ten days after Thornburgh announced it.
gates: An advisory is in force and the issuing office can revise it.
weights: A sustained improvement across the covered area favors lifting the whole advisory.
inGame: needs: expiration or partial withdrawal of an advisory.

turns.pulledBy: The latest assessment still meets the condition for issuing it.
turns.writesBack: The renewal records a new review date.

turns.what: One town receives clearance while a neighboring town remains covered.
turns.pulledBy: The findings differ across the boundary.
turns.writesBack: The advisory map shows where restrictions ended.
